place.name: Teta de Niquitao-Guirigay Natural Monument
place.description: The Teta de Niquitao-Guirigay Natural Natural Monument (Spanish: Monumento Natural Teta de Niquitao-Guirigay) Is a protected natural space located in the Trujillo state, in the Andes of Venezuela. It has the highest mountain in the state with a height of 4006 meters.
